title: Keto Chicken Crunch Toast
description: A crispy and savory keto snack made with chicken and crunchy toast.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into small pieces and season with salt and garlic powder.
Heat the warm oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned, then finish in the oven for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the crunchy toast slices until crispy.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
Once the chicken is cooked, toss with the soy sauce mixture and serve on top of the toasted crunchy toast.
